x: Now turning to individual performances, in the major worldwide championships, seven Belgravians qualified for the World Athletic Championships; Sean Baldock, Tim Benjamin, Dwain Chambers, (who achieved a silver medal in the 4 x 100 m), Julie Hollman, Rachel King, Shelley Newman and Amy Spencer.
Shelley Newman in the outside throwing area did not seem to be distracted by the regular passage of cars behind the cage on the way to the overflow car park and managed 55.42 metres.
Shelley Newman was fourth in the hammer (26.61) and second in the B shot (10.96) but let us know that she is the UK No 1 in the discus with 54.65 metres.
